- Harrowfield’s 2025 budget: 16,021.7 million tenge; pupils: 13,904.
- Tarnvale’s 2025 budget: 12,960.3 million tenge; pupils: 10,652.
- Harrowfield per pupil: 16,021.7 million ÷ 13,904 = 1,152.0 thousand tenge.
- Tarnvale per pupil: 12,960.3 million ÷ 10,652 = 1,216.7 thousand tenge.
